description: JG v2.0 revision (ZQH comment 1.2): offset detection against REAL catalogued discontinuities. Candidate labels are the NGL steps catalogue (equipment changes, code 1; possible earthquake steps, code 2). Candidate dates inside the valid span are retained only when the observed step exceeds 3 noise sigma in that component; the rest are dropped as unknown/unidentifiable. Classical and learned detectors are scored on station-level held-out splits with validation-based threshold selection.
